scoring_justification: Checker analytically integrates the Cp polynomial with the paper's coefficients and reference values, then compares agent's values pointwise with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Cp polynomial coefficients and reference thermodynamic values at 298 K.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section III and Table I; coefficients a, b, c, d and H_f(298), S_f(298) are explicitly reported.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the essential input parameters required to recompute the thermodynamic functions; they are not invented.

outputs.description: CSV file of Cp, S, G, H vs. temperature (298–1150 K in 50 K increments) computed from the Cp polynomial.
Temperature (K) where the computed enthalpy H(T) crosses zero, rounded to the nearest integer.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the thermodynamic functions from the supplied Cp polynomial and reference values; it compares the CSV pointwise within tolerances and verifies the zero-crossing temperature against the paper-reported value of 984 K within ±2 K. The integration step is mandatory because the zero-crossing depends on the computed H(T) values.

steps.description: Recompute Cp, S, H, G at each temperature and compare to agent's values within tolerances.
Check that the zero-enthalpy crossing temperature is within ±2 K of 984 K.
